authored_assumptions: The supplied opaque 2D portrait supplies appearance only; back, underside, rig, topology, UVs, weights and fur placement are newly authored.
Browser fur is a bounded skinned cutout-card groom; native Blender hair is separate editable geometry and is not exported as GLB hair. Neither representation simulates hair dynamics.
Arms and legs have continuous meshes with blended two-bone skinning. Torso, head, paws and facial components remain separate authored surfaces.
Eyes, eyelids, nose, mouth and paw digits are modeled geometry, not independently actuated facial muscles or fingers.
The green dragon stays attached to the torso-side anatomical-right shoulder helper; head, tail and wings have local authored controls only.
The golden orb is an authored action prop, not part of the reference portrait. Crafting gestures do not change its geometry or simulate manufacture.
General PBR edition: embedded normal maps, short fur and glossy surfaces have not been reduced to or approved by the Weft diffuse-only profile.
All native glTF transforms are authored meters/Y-up/+Z-front after Blender export; scale is not calibrated to the live simulator.
The neutral pose is arms resting beside the rounded body, feet flat, face forward; it is not an observed simulator pose.
The new continuous head deformation authors the muzzle and chin from visual interpretation; it is not a scan, image-to-mesh recovery or a new face control rig.
Iris and pupil geometry are glossy opaque curved shells. There is no refractive transparent cornea, painted catchlight or eye-tracking behavior.
Every iris uses disk UV0 centered at [0.5,0.5], rim radius 0.5; the central pupil shell covers part of the native radial color texture.
Dragon horn ridges, visible crown scales and thickened curved wing membranes are authored geometry; the remaining scales are procedural surface detail.
No new clip boundary, visual quality or hair-density claim follows from preserving authored keys. Native render and exported-model inspection remain required.
Existing native hair lengths are 1.8 times v1 and ribbon lengths 1.4 times v1. Hair remains static authored grooming following skin weights, without hair dynamics.
The solid three-spike forelock is removed. A low rounded emitter, mostly buried in the existing head, supplies a separate fine crown groom; no bare cone or triangle is used as a hair strand.
The new eye-patch offset is .033m from the authored face surface to cover the longer white head groom. Hair overlap and final facial-line visibility still require rendered inspection.
Panda iris radii are .0715/.0795m and pupil radius is 70% of the iris; dragon iris radii are .0365/.0415m and pupil radius is 72%. Radial UV0 and opaque glossy eye shells remain unchanged in meaning.
The surface plan is 22,020,096 pixels for two channels, plus one 1024-square card atlas per fur material; no external texture acquisition is involved.
The plush lighting and viewer-left camera are authored presentation choices, not a reference-camera calibration. Organic facial form still differs from Muse and no parity is asserted.

The v3 charcoal material changes sRGB color to[0.04,0.038,0.034,1] and existing procedural HD fur strength to0.06. This is an authored look adjustment, not reference-color calibration or a rendered improvement claim.

The fourteen previously bare panda foot/toe/paw-digit surfaces receive606 native parents with30 children, adding18,786 configured fibers and180 exported six-vertex hair cards. Dragon feet and all other surfaces are unchanged.

The complete v3 recipe requests7,688 skinned hair cards and at most238,328 configured native parent/child hairs. Native Blender strands are not exported as GLB hairs, and these counts are not independently counted rendered fibers.

All v2 geometry, existing grooms, ivory/facial materials, UVs, rig, attachments, four clips and presentation settings are preserved. The shorter added contact fur can intersect the unchanged authored floor; it is not contact simulation.
Native hair is authored into directional rest-space curves, retaining the emitter skin; there is no dynamic hair simulation. The GLB contains its separate masked-card coat.

fur_representation.native: editable native groom with per-material cutout visibility

initialization.method: Particle Edit enter/exit on owned emitter

limitations: Apply once to a fresh groom in its rest pose; counts/topology changes can regenerate hair.
The vector is in emitter object axes; no panda-specific direction or recovered grooming.
Stored parent arc length is preserved; interpolated render paths can add configured roughness/clump variation.
Native Blender hair is not exported as glTF geometry or browser hair.
Material uses the source base-color value, not sampled texture colors; use separate material regions.
Hair follows the copied emitter's same armature; keep emitter topology unchanged after grooming.
The caller caps aggregate fibers at 240000 and excludes native groom objects from GLB selection.

native_parameters.radius_semantics: Input is authoring-space radius at unit meter scale; Blender multiplies diameter properties by radius_scale
native_parameters.root_radius_description: Strand diameter width at the root

native_grooms.render_count_scope: Configured parents plus interpolated children; not an independently counted image feature

authored_assumptions: The supplied opaque 2D portrait supplies appearance only; back, underside, rig, topology, UVs, weights and fur placement are newly authored.
Browser fur is a bounded skinned cutout-card groom; native Blender hair is separate editable geometry and is not exported as GLB hair. Neither representation simulates hair dynamics.
Arms and legs have continuous meshes with blended two-bone skinning. Torso, head, paws and facial components remain separate authored surfaces.
Eyes, eyelids, nose, mouth and paw digits are modeled geometry, not independently actuated facial muscles or fingers.
The green dragon stays attached to the torso-side anatomical-right shoulder helper; head, tail and wings have local authored controls only.
The golden orb is an authored action prop, not part of the reference portrait. Crafting gestures do not change its geometry or simulate manufacture.
General PBR edition: embedded normal maps, short fur and glossy surfaces have not been reduced to or approved by the Weft diffuse-only profile.
All native glTF transforms are authored meters/Y-up/+Z-front after Blender export; scale is not calibrated to the live simulator.
The neutral pose is arms resting beside the rounded body, feet flat, face forward; it is not an observed simulator pose.
The new continuous head deformation authors the muzzle and chin from visual interpretation; it is not a scan, image-to-mesh recovery or a new face control rig.
Iris and pupil geometry are glossy opaque curved shells. There is no refractive transparent cornea, painted catchlight or eye-tracking behavior.
Every iris uses disk UV0 centered at [0.5,0.5], rim radius 0.5; the central pupil shell covers part of the native radial color texture.
Dragon horn ridges, visible crown scales and thickened curved wing membranes are authored geometry; the remaining scales are procedural surface detail.
No new clip boundary, visual quality or hair-density claim follows from preserving authored keys. Native render and exported-model inspection remain required.
Existing native hair lengths are 1.8 times v1 and ribbon lengths 1.4 times v1. Hair remains static authored grooming following skin weights, without hair dynamics.
The solid three-spike forelock is removed. A low rounded emitter, mostly buried in the existing head, supplies a separate fine crown groom; no bare cone or triangle is used as a hair strand.
The new eye-patch offset is .033m from the authored face surface to cover the longer white head groom. Hair overlap and final facial-line visibility still require rendered inspection.
Panda iris radii are .0715/.0795m and pupil radius is 70% of the iris; dragon iris radii are .0365/.0415m and pupil radius is 72%. Radial UV0 and opaque glossy eye shells remain unchanged in meaning.
The surface plan is 22,020,096 pixels for two channels, plus one 1024-square card atlas per fur material; no external texture acquisition is involved.
The plush lighting and viewer-left camera are authored presentation choices, not a reference-camera calibration. Organic facial form still differs from Muse and no parity is asserted.

The v3 charcoal material changes sRGB color to[0.04,0.038,0.034,1] and existing procedural HD fur strength to0.06. This is an authored look adjustment, not reference-color calibration or a rendered improvement claim.

The fourteen previously bare panda foot/toe/paw-digit surfaces receive606 native parents with30 children, adding18,786 configured fibers and180 exported six-vertex hair cards. Dragon feet and all other surfaces are unchanged.

The complete v3 recipe requests7,688 skinned hair cards and at most238,328 configured native parent/child hairs. Native Blender strands are not exported as GLB hairs, and these counts are not independently counted rendered fibers.

All v2 geometry, existing grooms, ivory/facial materials, UVs, rig, attachments, four clips and presentation settings are preserved. The shorter added contact fur can intersect the unchanged authored floor; it is not contact simulation.
Native hair is authored into directional rest-space curves, retaining the emitter skin; there is no dynamic hair simulation. The GLB contains its separate masked-card coat.
